title: Actress Zeenat Aman Advocates for Live-In Relationships Before Marriage
summary: Actress Zeenat Aman has expressed her support for live-in relationships before marriage, suggesting that it allows individuals to understand each other better. She believes that being in a relationship for five years is more beneficial than being miserable for 15 years. This stance has sparked debate on the importance of compatibility and happiness in relationships.
summary_points: Zeenat Aman supports live-in relationships before marriage as a way to understand each other better.
She believes that being in a relationship for five years is more beneficial than being miserable for 15 years.
This stance emphasizes the importance of compatibility and happiness in relationships.
The debate surrounding live-in relationships highlights the need for individuals to prioritize their emotional well-being.
Zeenat Aman's comments have sparked discussion on the role of relationships in modern society.
